thread:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up — we need concrete owners and timelines for the customer comms pieces (status page, customer summary, public RCA policy). I sketched an owner checklist below. Please review and assign by EOD Wed.

katie: thanks — can you paste the suggested status copy here so we can iterate? also, do we want a short customer-facing timeline (what happened, mitigation, next steps) or a bulleted incident summary?

maria: short timeline + 3 bullet summary is my vote. here's a terse status page draft for review:

```
Incident: Token service degradation (partial)
Impact: API requests returning 500 for ~12% of requests between 02:12-02:39 UTC
Mitigation: Rolling restart of token-worker pool restored 99% of traffic by 02:29 UTC
Next steps: RCA in progress; customers will be notified when RCA is published
```

jon: language looks good. suggestion: add an estimated RCA publish date or "RCA forthcoming within X business days". customers appreciate an ETA.

katie: agree on ETA. propose: "RCA expected within 5 business days; we will update the status page when available." keeps expectations clear.

sam: on recurring pattern — we flagged similar token-worker restarts in the last 2 months (see incident-ids 178xxxx, 183xxxx). can we standardize remediation owners so these don't slip? my suggestion: infra -> owner for long-term fix, platform -> owner for immediate automations.

eli: +1. also need legal/compliance review for any external RCA content that contains customer-identifiable details. @katie can we add a quick redaction checklist?

katie: yes. proposed redaction checklist for customer/public summaries: 1) remove customer IDs/IPs, 2) remove exact timestamps for individual customer events, 3) summarize error types without verbatim logs, 4) confirm legal sign-off if PII may have been exposed.

maria: excellent. here is the owner/timeline matrix I propose — please reply with an assignee (Slack handle) next to each row: 
- Status page update: owner -> (assign) ; ETA -> 6 hours from assignment
- Customer email summary: owner -> (assign); ETA -> 24 hours
- Public RCA doc: owner -> (assign); ETA -> 5 business days
- Long-term remediation project: owner -> (assign); ETA -> proposal in 10 business days
- Follow-up retro to check recurring pattern: owner -> (assign); ETA -> schedule within 2 weeks

jon: I can take customer email summary. assigning to @jon.

sam: I'll take long-term remediation project and the recurring pattern retro. assigning to @sam.

katie: I'll own status page update and redaction checklist + legal coordination. assigning to @katie.

eli: I'll do a legal pre-check on the RCA content, then hand off for final sign-off. assigning to @eli.

maria: great — I'll own the public RCA doc draft and coordinate sign-offs. assigning to @maria.

status-bot: Incident digest posted to status.redwood.ai — update queued for author @katie.

maria: Next steps and quick coordination items:
- @katie: publish status page update with ETA copy within 6h
- @jon: customer email draft by EOD tomorrow
- @maria/@eli/@katie: RCA draft + legal review timeline set (5 business days)
- @sam: schedule recurring-pattern retro and add examples to the RCA

Please react with :thumbsup: when you’ve noted your assignments or reply if you need longer timelines. If anyone needs support (standup time, docs, examples), ping me and I’ll reassign scope.

katie: :thumbsup: will post status update now and link here when live.

jon: :thumbsup: will start the email draft and drop a copy in #customer-success for review.

sam: scheduling the retro for next Tue, sending invites to infra + platform + ops.

eli: legal will try to turn reviews around within 48 hours once draft is available.

maria: thanks all — will follow up with a short tracker doc (owners, ETA, status) and post it here. closing thread for active assignment tracking, will reopen if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
